rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Ohm's law.** At constant physical conditions (temperature, state) the potential difference across a conductor is directly proportional to the current: V ∝ I, or V = IR.  ·  **Resistance and resistivity.** R = ρL/A: resistance grows with length L and falls with area A; resistivity ρ (unit Ω·m) is a property of the material itself.  ·  **Temperature dependence.** For metals R_t = R_0(1 + αt) with α > 0; semiconductors have negative temperature coefficient as carrier density rises with heat.
